🇮🇪 #JESC26: Caleb Kirwan & Naomi Gribben Release “Níos Láidre (Stronger)”

By escppeurovision on October 4, 2026 • ( Leave a comment )
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

TG4, the Irish national broadcaster, have released their entry, for the 2026 Junior Eurovision Song Contest, in Ta’ Qali.

TG4 have released Caleb Kirwin & Naomi Gribben’s entry for the 2026 Junior Eurovision Song Contest, in Ta’ Qali, “Níos Láidre (Stronger)” – which you can watch below:

Let us know what you think about Ireland and the 2026 Junior Eurovision Song Contest – either in the comments below or on our FACEBOOK, BLUESKY, TWITTER, YOUTUBE, INSTAGRAM and TIKTOK pages.
